result.title: Crafting the Difference, Grounding the Evidence: Discriminative Concept Learning for Zero-Shot Skeleton Action Recognition
result.summary: LLM-generated descriptions enrich zero-shot skeleton-based action recognition but repeat cues shared by confusable actions. Their contextual semantics also lack explicit links to skeleton features. To address these challenges, we propose CRAFT, which couples Concept Refinement and Feature-grounded Tokens. Hard-negative-conditioned generation and contrastive scoring identify concepts that distinguish each action from its closest rivals. Unique-QDPP selects complementary descriptions within each semantic slot and prevents their reuse across slots. This bank supervises learnable concept tokens that read motion and context cues from each skeleton. On fixed NTU-60 and NTU-120 splits, CRAFT improves five baselines spanning four recognition paradigms. ZSL accuracy and GZSL harmonic mean increase on every baseline-split pair, by 5.4 and 5.9 percentage points on average. Random-split experiments extend these gains to three datasets, including PKU-MMD. Code will be released after acceptance.

AI.brief_summary: 针对零样本骨架动作识别中 LLM 描述重复混淆动作共同线索、且与骨架特征缺乏显式对应的问题，提出 CRAFT：用难负例条件下的生成与对比打分筛出区分性概念，并以可学习概念 token 从骨架中读取运动与上下文线索，在多个基线与划分上提升 ZSL 与 GZSL 指标。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「概念 token 由特征接地、并用难负例对比筛选区分性概念」的做法，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态如何绑定具体视觉证据、以及如何剔除混淆性冗余证据；但任务为骨架模态的动作分类而非多模态推理，迁移性需人工判断。
